dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ìwọ mọ́ pé àwọn ọkàn wa tún gbà lówọ̀ ẹ̀yìn tí àwọn àgbà wọ̀nyí fún kárùnà àwọn ọmọdé? Jọ̀wọ́, mú kán dínà bí àwọn àgbà wọ̀nyí.
dialogue.translation: Do you know that our hearts again accept the side of the elders’ opinion for the sake of the youth? Please, find a way that aligns with the elders’ reasoning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo mọ́ pé ọkàn wa fún ẹ̀yìn tí àwọn àgbà wọ̀nyí, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yìn tí àwọn ọmọdé yẹ kàn pẹ́. Rárá, tí àwọn àgbà ba ti pà, kí ni a ṣe?
dialogue.translation: I know that our hearts are for the elders’ sake, but the youth’s sake must also be satisfied. Not at all, if the elders’ opinion happens, what should we do?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo tún gbà pé àwọn ọmọdé lọ́wọ́ pà àwọn àgbà. Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn àgbà kàn dínà tí a jẹ kí àwọn ọmọdé mọ́ pé a ti gbà gẹ́gẹ́ bí 'gbà' lóhùn.
dialogue.translation: I also accept that the youth are the ones who act on the elders’ behalf. But the elders must find a way so that the youth understand that we have already accepted it fully.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí o ba ti ṣe, ṣé àwọn ọmọdé yẹ kàn lówọ̀? Mo bá a jẹ kí wọn mọ́ pé a ti mọ̀ pé àwọn àgbà a fún ẹ̀yìn àwọn ìwà ọmọdé?
dialogue.translation: If you do that, should the youth’s sake be satisfied? I agree that they should know that we already know the elders will act for the sake of the youth’s character.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bí àwọn ọmọdé ba ti mọ̀ pé àwọn àgbà a fún wọn lówọ̀, ṣé àwọn àgbà yẹ kàn lówọ̀ pẹ́? Mo fún un pé a ti jẹ bí ọkàn wa tún gbà lówọ̀ ẹ̀yìn wọn.
dialogue.translation: If the youth know that the elders will act on their behalf, should the elders’ sake be satisfied only? I say that we have accepted it wholeheartedly for their sake.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo tún gbà pé ẹ̀yìn tí àwọn àgbà a fún wọn lówọ̀ yẹ kàn pẹ́. Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọdé lọ́wọ́ ri pé àwọn àgbà a fún wọn lówọ̀, bí a ti ṣe?
dialogue.translation: I also accept that the elders’ sake must be satisfied only. But the youth will see that the elders act on their behalf, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bí àwọn ọmọdé ba ti rí pé àwọn àgbà a fún wọn lówọ̀, a ti ṣe kán dínà tí a jẹ kí àwọn àgbà mọ́ pé àwọn ọmọdé a ṣe rárá gbà àwọn ìwà àgbà.
dialogue.translation: If the youth see that the elders act on their behalf, we have found a way so that the elders know that the youth will not at all accept the elders’ ways.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo mọ́ pé àwọn ọkàn wa gbà lówọ̀ ẹ̀yìn wọn pẹ́. Ṣùgbọ́n àwọn àgbà a kàn kárùnà tí a jẹ kí àwọn ọmọdé mọ́ pé a ti gbà gẹ́gẹ́ bí 'gbà' lóhùn.
dialogue.translation: I know that our hearts accept their sake only. But the elders must find a reason so that the youth understand that we have already fully accepted it.

dialogue.translation: Do you know where these social media accounts are located? And if the accounts are many, we can help you organize them properly.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: Bí mo ba wà lẹ́, mo le mọ̀ nǹkan tó dára. Ṣugbọn bí mo ba dà nǹkan, mo le ṣe àyọ̀wọ̀ àti àwọn ọkàtún afọwọ́kọ́ fún àwọn ènìyàn. Ṣé o gbà?
dialogue.translation: If I stay here, I can understand better. But if I close something, I can create awareness and guide people. Is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: Òótọ̀, àti bí àwọn ènìyàn mọ̀ bí àwọn àgbọ́n adìre wà nílé-ìwé, a le fún wọn ní àwọn àkọ́kọ́ àti àwọn ọkàtún tó dara. Ṣé àwọn ènìyàn sì mọ̀ bí àwọn àgbọ́n adìre lè dà ọlọ́wọ́?
dialogue.translation: Truly, and if people know where the social media accounts are in the house, we can give them proper lessons and guidance. Do people know that social media can be harmful?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: Bí wọn ba mọ̀, wọn le ṣe àwọn ọkàtún tó dúpẹ́ fún ọkàn wọn. Ṣugbọn bí wọn bá dà ní ọkàn wọn, wọn le ṣe àwọn ọkàtún tó jẹ́ àwọn ẹ̀yìn tó dára.
dialogue.translation: If they know, they can create positive content for themselves. But if they close their minds, they may create harmful content.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: Bí àwọn ènìyàn ba wà ní àwọn àgbọ́n adìre, wọn le gbà ẹ̀kọ́ tó dara. Àti bí wọn ba dà ní ọkàn wọn, wọn le ṣe ìtọ̀jú tó dún. Ṣé o mọ̀ àpẹ́rẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: If people use social media, they can receive good education. And if they open their minds, they can do satisfying research. Do you understand an example?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: Báwo ni a ṣe le fún àwọn ènìyàn ní àwọn ìtọ̀jú tó dára fún àgbọ́n adìre? Mo wà lẹ́ ní ìdí rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: How can we provide people with good guidance for social media? I am here to support you.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: Dàadì, bí àwọn ènìyàn ba mọ̀ bí àwọn àgbọ́n adìre wà nínú àwọn iṣẹ́ àti àwọn iṣowo, wọn le ṣe ọwọ́ púpọ̀. Àti bí wọn ba dà ọkàn wọn, wọn le ṣe àwọn ọkàtún tó gbà.
dialogue.translation: Indeed, if people know where social media exists in work and business, they can do a lot. And if they open their minds, they can create content that is enough (beneficial).

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: Mo dúpẹ́ fún ọ, a o ṣe ọwọ́ púpọ̀ fún àwọn ènìyàn ní àwọn ìtọ̀jú tó dára fún àgbọ́n adìre.
dialogue.translation: Thank you, we will do a lot to provide people with good guidance for social media.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, mo lọ́ pàpà fún rúgbẹ̀ àti àtùkọ́ tó ba jẹ́kú fún àwọn ẹ̀rọ àti àwọn ilera wa.

dialogue.text: Kì í ṣe nípa ọ̀nà kan kan, ṣugbọn nípa ìmọ̀lẹ̀ lọ́wọ̀ àwọn àgbọn. A kì í ṣe gbọ́n nípa àwọn ẹ̀yìn tí a lọ sí.
dialogue.translation: It's not about a single path, but about the knowledge power of the educated. We aren't strong about the paths we've taken.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo dá ẹ̀yìn yìí láti ìmọ̀lẹ̀, ṣugbọn mo gbẹ́ pé àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ àgbọn kò ṣe dé bí a ti fẹ́.
dialogue.translation: I created this path from knowledge, but I fear that many educated people haven't arrived as we hoped.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, àwọn ẹ̀yìn tí a wọ̀ lẹ́yìn ìmọ̀lẹ̀ jẹ́ àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ ìmọ̀lẹ̀ ní ọ̀nà yìí.
dialogue.translation: Yes, the paths we've taken after knowledge are those of the educated leaders in this system.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fé kí àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ àgbọn máa lọ́wọ̀ láti ṣe ìmọ̀lẹ̀ dára, ṣugbọn àwọn ẹ̀yìn tí a lọ sí jẹ́ àwọn ìmọ̀lẹ̀ kan kan.
dialogue.translation: I want educated leaders to keep working to improve knowledge, but the paths we've taken are just a few knowledge paths.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ ìmọ̀lẹ̀ ni àwọn tí a gbà láti ṣe ìmọ̀lẹ̀ dára bẹ́ẹ̀, ṣugbọn àwọn ẹ̀yìn ẹ̀yìn lọ́wọ̀ ni àwọn àgbọn tí kò mọ̀.
dialogue.translation: It's the educated leaders who are accepted to improve knowledge this way, but the other paths are for those who don't know.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo mọ̀ pé ẹ̀yìn tí a ti wọ ẹ̀yìn ní ìtọ́jú kì í ṣe gbọ́n bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ́wọ̀ ọ̀nà tí a dé.

key_phrases.translation: I want educated leaders to keep working to improve knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo gbà pé a lágbára l'ọwọ́ àwọn onírẹ̀rẹ̀ ètò. Mo ṣéhun tí a kò dé àti tí a jín lówó.
dialogue.translation: I accept that those in leadership positions are strong, but the issues we haven’t addressed and those we’ve cleaned up remain.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣélẹ̀ fún mi kí n lè tó ṣéda àti tó tún ṣéṣé? Àwọn ohun tí a pàtápàta lòwọ́ kòkò.
dialogue.translation: Is it easy for me to do this and do it again? The things we’ve directly addressed are at the core.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dúró yẹn l'ẹ̀yìn, bí a bá sì lówọ́ ọgbọn àti ọlọ́rọ̀, a lè tún ṣélẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: That’s difficult afterwards, but if we have good intentions and wisdom, we can make it easy again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo fẹ́ kí a tún dé àwọn ọjọ́ ètò tí a sì lágbára l'ọwọ́ ètò.
dialogue.translation: I want us to revisit the policy days when we were stronger in governance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bí a ba ṣéṣé àwọn ohun tí a kò gbà, a lè jẹ́ pé àwọn àgbọ́n tó dára sì dé.
dialogue.translation: If we do the things we haven’t accepted, we can say the good ones have arrived.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbà pé àwọn ohun tí a jín lówó sì ṣélẹ̀ fún wa l'ohun tí a fẹ́.
dialogue.translation: I accept that the things we’ve cleaned up are now easy for us to handle.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣélẹ̀ bá a lówọ́ ọlọ́rọ̀ àti àwọn àfẹ́sí, a lè ṣéṣé àti tún ṣéṣé.
dialogue.translation: With wisdom and resources, we can act and act again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo dé pa tí mo ba lè ṣe àwọn ohun wọ̀nyí l'akọkọ́.
dialogue.translation: I’ve arrived at the point where I can do these things first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o ma lòwọ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àgbá?
dialogue.translation: Do you usually work closely with the elders?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀, mo tún gbà lówó tó pàtá ní ẹ̀kọ́ àgbá. Ẹ̀yin tún ṣé fún mi ní àyọ̀nà.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I also receive great support from the elders. You also guide me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo dájú pé àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àgbá jẹ́ àwọn olùṣẹ́ ètò. Tẹ́lẹ̀, mo fún àwọn iṣẹ́ náà lówọ́.
dialogue.translation: I am sure the elders are the backbone. Right away, I give them authority over the tasks.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dípò pé àwọn ènìyàn ma pàtàkù sí ẹ̀kọ́ àgbá, àwọn olùkọ́ ni a gbà lówọ́.
dialogue.translation: Because people don’t always respect elders, we empower the teachers.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo tún dé ní gbogbo àgbà nígbà tí mo bá fún àwọn ọmọdé lówọ́.
dialogue.translation: I also arrive at all elders’ meetings when I delegate authority to the youth.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣélẹ̀ a ba fé sí ṣé àti ṣédá pàtàkù ní ẹ̀kọ́, a gbọ́gbọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé.
dialogue.translation: So that we can manage and organize properly in school, we listen to the youth.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Èyí ni àwọn ọjọ̀ àgbá àti àwọn ọmọdé ṣé àti ṣédá ṣé kí àlàáfia dé.
dialogue.translation: This is how elders and youth work together so that peace can come.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ìwọ pàtá fún àwọn ènìyàn lówọ́ ní àgbá àti àwọn ọmọdé. Mo gbàgbọ́ pé èyí ni ìmọ̀.
dialogue.translation: You very much empower people in both elders and youth. I believe this is wisdom.
